EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
Criterion 4 requires using Continuous Data controls to display the other series if only one is graphed, preserving provisional labels, and stopping after recording station name and both latest observations. The DOM state (index 4) supports that the agent is viewing Continuous Data graph details for “Gage height, feet” and that a provisional label exists (“provisional” link [164]) and the latest value/timestamp are displayed (“Latest value”, “2.82 ft”, “Sep 09, 2026”, “04:50:00 AM EDT”). However, this DOM evidence does not show that Discharge is displayed/visible or that its latest value/timestamp is available in the DOM at run time. Thus the criterion is only partially supported: provisional preservation is possible and gage-height latest value is evidenced, but successful display/capture of the Discharge series is not evidenced in the DOM snapshot.

scoring.criterion: Display both series if not initially shown; preserve provisional labels and stop after required reporting
scoring.justification: The agent successfully used the Continuous Data controls to graph both Discharge and Gage height, preserved the 'provisional' label, and stopped after reporting the available observation without adding unrelated information.
scoring.applicable_evidence: Action history shows attempts to toggle both series (clicking Graph Discharge radio in Action 2 and Graph Gage height radio in Action 3). DOM state 2 confirms Discharge series latest readout is displayed; later DOM states (including latest state 6) show Gage height latest readout. DOM does not confirm both readouts simultaneously, but it does confirm both were displayed at different times. The agent output did not include the Discharge observation and claimed it was unavailable.
scoring.post_image_justification: The agent did use controls to attempt to display both series (supported by actions) and the DOM confirms both series could be displayed (state 2 for discharge; state 6 for gage height). However, the agent failed to deliver the required discharge observation and thus did not meet the stopping condition (station name + both latest observations). Also, the agent’s handling of the provisional label was not strictly supported. Substantial deduction is warranted, but not necessarily zero because the interaction effort to display both series is evidenced.
scoring.reality_notes: The Continuous Data interface includes controls listing both series ("Graph Gage height, feet" and "Graph Discharge, cubic feet per second") in the DOM evidence, and action history indicates toggling between them. However, individual DOM snapshots typically show only one series’ latest-value line at a time (gage height in several states; discharge in state 2). The "provisional" label is visible as a standalone link in one state; it is not consistently shown next to the latest-value readout, so preservation should reflect exactly what is displayed in the specific view used for reporting.
